findings.title: SSRF Bypass of Localhost-Restricted Admin Interface
findings.description: The /convert endpoint accepts a URL parameter and fetches its content server-side, enabling Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF). This was exploited to bypass the localhost-only restriction on the /admin interface by using the IP address 127.1 (which resolves to 127.0.0.1). The admin interface at /admin/flag was accessed via SSRF, revealing the CTF flag.
